validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="s">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="x" expr="1" src="file:x.json">
      <value/>
    </data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="s">
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<data>` declares more than one value source: `expr`, `src`, and the child content

secondary.message: the child content is declared here too

notes: `<data>` gets its initial value from exactly one of `src` (a URI), `expr` (an expression), or inline child content; with several the value is ambiguous
diagnostics.help: keep one value source and remove the other 2: for example, remove `expr` and `src`
